parole.significato: to poke, to jab, to goad
parole.testo: * According to BER: Derived from Latin castrō (“to castrate”), via a Balkan dialect of Vulgar Latin, otherwise yielding standard Bulgarian ка́стря (kástrja, “to castrate”). * Trubačev (ЭССЯ): Inherited from Proto-Slavic *kustriti, cognate with Slovak kustriť /kúšriť (“to shiver, to convulse”).
Calque of Latin adverbium, formed from наре́ка (naréka, “to call”) + -ие (-ie). Formally reflects Proto-Slavic *narěčьje.
